stufen.beleg: An office, appointee or delegation exists that could carry the proposal out.

A final rule, an enacted statute, a signed rescission, a completed programme termination.
The effective date has passed and no court order suspends it.
Upheld on judicial review, or written into statute, so that it survives a change of administration.
